product_family: AI Model Hub and Inference Platform. Core products: Hub (model/dataset repository), Inference Endpoints (serverless deployment), Inference Providers (45k+ models via unified API), Spaces (app hosting), HuggingChat (consumer AI assistant), Storage Buckets (data storage). Enterprise tiers include SSO, SCIM, audit logs, data residency controls.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: The Hugging Face Hub, Inference Endpoints, and Inference Providers are all SOC 2 Type II certified. [We] provide security certification to our customers and actively monitor and patch any security weaknesses.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Hugging Face does not currently publish an ISO/IEC 27001 certification. However, most enterprise customers accept the SOC 2 Type II report as equivalent assurance, since the two standards have substantial control overlap.

privacy.ai_training_note: Hugging Face does not use customer data, models, or datasets for training their own AI systems. HuggingChat conversations are explicitly private and not used for model training. Feedback usage is reserved but only for aggregated/anonymized insights. Private repositories are protected with reasonable measures.
privacy.data_region: US (default), EU, Asia-Pacific (coming soon). Data residency controls available on Team+ plans. For EU compliance, EU region ensures GDPR-compliant storage in EU data centers.
sources: Search results on HuggingChat privacy and data training

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS/SSL encryption on all data transfers (Inference Endpoints, Serverless Inference API, Inference Provider routing)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: At-rest encryption on managed storage (Enterprise feature)

security.name: Authentication & Access Control
security.value: User access tokens, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), Resource Groups with fine-grained RBAC, SSO (SAML 2.0 / OIDC) on Enterprise

security.name: Single Sign-On (SSO)
security.value: SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) supported on Enterprise; supports Okta, Azure AD, OneLign, etc.

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logs on Team+ plans; logs retained for compliance review

security.name: Code & Malware Scanning
security.value: Malware scanning and Pickle scanning on model repositories; third-party scanners (Protect AI, JFrog) integrated

security.name: Secrets Scanning
security.value: Automated detection and scanning for hardcoded secrets in repositories

security.name: Git over SSH & GPG Commit Signing
security.value: Secure Git operations and commit authentication options

security.name: Private Network Connectivity
security.value: AWS PrivateLink and Azure PrivateLink support for Inference Endpoints (Enterprise feature)

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: Region selection (US, EU, APAC coming) with performance and compliance benefits; 4-5x faster EU transfers when stored in EU

security.name: Token Management & Revocation
security.value: Fine-grained tokens with per-resource permissions; token revocation API on Enterprise

products.name: Hugging Face Hub
products.data_scope: Public and private models, datasets, Spaces applications, storage buckets
products.notes: Core platform with 2M+ models and 500k+ datasets. SOC 2 Type II certified. Free tier available with basic security; Team and Enterprise tiers add audit logs, SSO, SCIM, data residency.

products.name: Inference Endpoints
products.data_scope: Model inputs/outputs, inference logs retained for up to 30 days (no customer data stored)
products.notes: SOC 2 Type II certified. TLS/SSL encryption in transit. Private network (PrivateLink) support on Enterprise. Logs do not store request/response bodies or user tokens.

products.name: Inference Providers
products.data_scope: Routing to 45,000+ models via single API; no data retention for inference calls
products.notes: SOC 2 Type II certified. TLS/SSL encryption in transit. Vendors include leading AI providers. No storage of customer inference data.

products.name: Spaces
products.data_scope: App code and runtime; stored in selected region (Team+ feature)
products.notes: Supports both CPU and GPU compute. Data residency available on Team+. Some advanced features (ZeroGPU) may not be available in all regions.

products.name: HuggingChat
products.data_scope: Conversation history (stored for user's access only, not for training)
products.notes: Privacy-first: conversations not used for model training or research. No model author visibility into user conversations. Authenticated via HF account.

products.name: Storage Buckets
products.data_scope: User-managed file storage with regional options
products.notes: Data residency controls available on Team+ (US, EU, APAC coming). At-rest encryption on managed storage.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered subscription. Free (basic public repos), Team ($20/user/month), Enterprise ($50+/user/month custom), Enterprise Plus (custom). Compute/storage available on PAYG model.
compare.data_residency: Yes, on Team+ plans. Regions: US (default), EU (GDPR-compliant), Asia-Pacific (coming soon). Enterprise can audit and control repository storage location.
top_certs: SOC 2 Type II (Hub, Inference Endpoints, Inference Providers)

flags: ISO 27001 certification NOT held. Hugging Face positions SOC 2 Type II as equivalent for enterprise audits due to substantial control overlap. Organizations requiring ISO 27001 must assess SOC 2 Type II acceptability.

HIPAA only available as Business Associate Agreement (BAA) on Enterprise plan. This is NOT full HIPAA compliance certification, only a contract vehicle for HIPAA-regulated customers. Full compliance responsibility remains with the customer organization.
No evidence of PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CSA STAR, ISO 27017/27018/27701, or ISO 42001 (AI governance) certifications. Vendors requiring these must contact Hugging Face directly.
Data residency features (EU/APAC regions) require Team or Enterprise plan. Free users store data in US by default.
GDPR DPA and HIPAA BAA agreements only available on Enterprise plan ($50+/user/month). Team plan does not include these compliance addendums.
SOC 2 Type II audit report is available 'under NDA from your account team'; not publicly available. Third-party verification limited.
Feedback and aggregated usage data is reserved for Hugging Face use (learning/improvement), though it is anonymized. Privacy-conscious organizations should review terms carefully.
